generation.scope: Every finite rank-ten both-bundle window admits a quartic K3 with two residual elliptic octic pencils. Four shifted line bundles realize its full finite Frobenius cohomology algebra. The product of their four spherical twists factors, up to shift two, into tensoring by the two negative fiber classes with an explicit two-twist conjugation.

open_mathematics: Relate the two-twist conjugation to linear determinantal presentations on the elliptic octics and use the resulting fiber objects to control Serre purity.
